text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Zenno Rob Roy<n>excitedly chattering
away at Agnes<n>Digital.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The choice of paper, the ink, the<n>ribbon bookmark,
the binding... Every<n>last detail of the original print
has<n>been expertly recreated, right down to<n>the
materials and methods used!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh, thank youuu! It means so,<n>so much that
you recognize all the<n>effort that went into it!
choice_data_list:
All right, I'm curious—what are you two talking
about?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello! We were just talking about<n>this book.
Isn't it magnificent?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's a reprint of an old novel, done by<n>Digital's
family's printshop!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And the craftsmanship is absolutely<n>superb! When I
spotted Digital, I<n>couldn't help but get carried away
gushing about the quality.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I mean, I didn't do anything, but I'm<n>sure my dad
will be over the moon<n>when I tell him!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yep, he's a total nerd when it comes<n>to books.
He's been crazy locked in<n>on the reprint project
since the very<n>first planning talk.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A total... nerd? It sounds like the apple<n>didn't fall far
from the tree, then!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh, I-I guess. We are both superpassionate about our interests.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll admit that I do take after him a lot.

text_block_list.name: Digital's Father
text_block_list.text: Yeees! I finally found the perfectpaper! It's just glossy enough to feelsmooth while letting a little lightthrough when flipped. It's just matteenough to prevent annoying ink glareall while preventing bleed throughfrom the page under!

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text:
Daaad, why are you running around<n>the office
shouting? What's so<n>exciting about paper?

text_block_list.name: Digital's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there, Digi. The thing about<n>paper is, it holds
bazillions of<n>possibilities—and all of them are
breathtaking! ☆ Paper is where it's at!

text_block_list.name: Digital's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You should explore hobbies<n>and find
something that makes you<n>extra special happy,
Digi. Life's so<n>much fun when you've got an
interest to fangirl over. ♪

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(It was a few years later that I found<n>my ultimate
passion. It was a normal<n>day like any other. I was
playing in<n>the breakroom at Dad's<n>printshop—until
fate put that show on<n>the TV...)

text_block_list.name: Documentary
text_block_list.text:
A professional racer starts her routine<n>bright and
early—even on the day<n>after losing the G1 race she
worked<n>so hard for. Tears glitter in her eyes<n>as she
pushes herself forward,<n>running around the training
track.

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text: Gasp! She's... She's so... so noble!

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah, w-what is this feeling? Why<n>does my heart
feel like she's<n>squeezing it harder with each beat?!

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text:
What's happening to me?<n>D-DAAAAAD!
MOOOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: After my fangirl awakening, myparents bought me a whole bunch ofbooks and merch. Next thing I knew, Iwas deep in the Umamusume racing fandom.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
By the time I graduated from<n>elementary school, I
was already a<n>hardcore Uma otaku.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back, it's kinda crazy how<n>happy they
were for me figuring out<n>what I love.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Like, if they hadn't thrown their full<n>support behind
me the way they did, I<n>don't think I would be the
person I<n>am now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So I really have to hand it to them<n>both for how
wonderful every day<n>feels. Y-Y'know what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Of course. It's a lovely thing—the way<n>you're able
to wholeheartedly devote<n>yourself to your interests.
And I'm<n>sure your parents knew the feeling.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
They're both amazing people...<n>encouraging their
daughter's love so<n>earnestly.
choice_data_list: You really do have some spectacular parents.

I think your flexibility on the track is a testament to
it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hwaaa?! Trainer? ...You think so too?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But... I really am super lucky. I'm glad<n>I have
parents that encourage me to<n>love what I love.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Ehehe! I won't lie though, it is<n>kinda
embarrassing having all the<n>attention on little old
Digitan!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Digital's so knowledgeable<n>about
Umamusume racing. You have<n>such a strong grasp
of history and<n>tactics.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, you also make the<n>time to
pursue art and creative<n>writing. You've made all
kinds of<n>fanworks, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: HWACK?! H-how do you—who told<n>you that?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uh, um, s-so uh... You've gotta<n>understand, people
have been writing<n>fanfics since time immemorial! A
lot of<n>famous, historic literature was made<n>by fans
of earlier works! I-it's<n>completely normal!!!!!
